newsitem.title: SPAIN: Montoro sees Spain 1H GDP up 3%, Mar CPI "good".
newsitem.headline: Montoro sees Spain 1H GDP up 3%, Mar CPI "good".

text.p: Spanish Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said on Tuesday gross domestic product should grow about three percent in the first half of 1997, while inflation data will be good in March and the coming months.
"We'll have growth of around three percent, it'll be at around this rate in the first half of the year, if not at about that level," Montoro told reporters at a news conference.
Asked about the March Consumer Price Index, due on Friday, Montoro said "We'll have a good inflation number and in the coming months as well".
